== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-rebelsquadleader-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Rebel Squad Leader]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[Rebel Squad Leader (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “Adds 1 to forfeit of your other troopers and Rebel Guards at same site.” is added at the start; “other” is added after “of exactly three”; “Your troopers and” is dropped; “are forfeit +1. Rebel Guards” is dropped; “move with Rebel Squad Leader (at normal use of the Force).” becomes “move.”. These are the same words as [[Rebel Squad Leader (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “Rebel Squad Leader” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
